logs.title: Log
logs.empty: The log is empty so far.

about.all: Everything goes through the server, the local network directly.
about.hardened: Like All traffic, plus TLS fragmentation. Helps when the connection keeps breaking.

wizard.tagline: Quick setup takes less than a minute.

subscription.title: Add a subscription
subscription.text: Paste the link from your provider, and Poros will load its servers. It usually comes in an email or from a bot after payment.
subscription.label: Subscription link

start.title: How to start Poros
start.autostartHint: Poros opens when you sign in.
start.autoConnectHint: Right after it starts, Poros connects to the server that worked last time.
start.urlSchemeHint: A link from a site or a messenger opens straight in Poros.
start.note: Windows keeps autostart and links outside the Poros folder. They can be turned off in the settings.

routing.title: Which traffic goes through the server
routing.note: The preset can be changed at any time on the main screen.

hint.both: TUN takes all of the computer's traffic through the server, and System also points programs at the proxy directly.
hint.tun: All of the computer's traffic goes through the server, games and programs included.
hint.system: Browsers and programs that use the system proxy go through the server.
hint.none: Without TUN and System only programs set to the proxy {address} go through the server.

list.emptyText: Paste a subscription link, and its servers will show up here.
list.removeText: “{name}” and its servers will be gone from Poros.

add.title: Add a subscription
add.name: Name
add.note: The subscription shows up on the main screen as a group of its own.

modes.title: How traffic goes through the server
modes.tun: All of the computer's traffic, games and programs without proxy settings included. Needs administrator rights.
modes.system: Browsers and programs that use the Windows system proxy. No rights needed.
modes.note: Both can be on. The choice is remembered; the switches are on the main screen under Start.

admin.title: TUN needs administrator rights
admin.text: TUN creates a network adapter in Windows, which only an administrator may do. The Poros core restarts with rights and connects to the server right away.
admin.failed: TUN did not start without administrator rights.

ip.title: IP and DNS
ip.connectFirst: Connect to see the exit address.
ip.unknown: The address could not be found.
ip.dns: DNS servers that see your queries
ip.noConnection: DNS leaks are checked through the connection. Press Start, and the check runs by itself.
ip.noLeakText: Only DNS servers on the VPN side see your queries.
ip.leakText: Some queries go past the server, and your provider sees which sites you open. Turn on TUN or a preset with DNS through the server.
ip.unknownLeak: A leak cannot be told: the provider without VPN is unknown.
ip.note: To check, Poros resolves a few random names and asks an outside service which DNS servers asked for them.
ip.off: The IP and DNS check is off in the settings.

restartBanner.text: The settings changed. Apply them to the connection? It breaks for a couple of seconds.

presets.lead: A preset decides which traffic goes through the server and which goes directly. Built-in presets do not change: to add your own settings, make a copy or a new preset.
presets.none: No presets of your own yet.
presets.removeText: “{name}” will be gone. If it is chosen, Poros goes back to “{base}”.

conn.lead: How Poros connects and what it does when the connection breaks. TUN and System are on the main screen.
conn.killSwitchHint: Block the internet if the connection to the server breaks.
conn.allowLanHint: A phone or TV on this network can go out through Poros.
conn.checkIpHint: Before and after connecting, Poros asks an outside service for the IP and DNS servers. Click the IP for details and DNS leaks.
conn.ipv6Hint: Off, sites open over IPv4 only, and IPv6 connections do not go past the server.
conn.realityHint: VLESS servers with REALITY run on Xray. Off, they run on sing-box.

subs.lead: How the server list is updated.
subs.viaProxyHint: Helps when the provider's site cannot be reached directly.
subs.showChangesHint: After an update by hand, show which servers came and went.
subs.deviceInfoHint: Needed by providers that limit the number of devices.

start.lead: The same as the Start step of quick setup.
start.startMinimizedHint: The window does not open, Poros stays in the tray.
start.closeToTray: Hide to the tray on close
start.closeToTrayHint: Off, the close button quits Poros.
start.urlSchemeOther: Another copy of Poros opens them now: {program}. Turn on to let this one open them.

look.lead: Language and size of the interface.

help.wizardHint: Go through the first-start steps again.
help.resetHint: Restarts the core if TUN stopped working.

linkPreset.title: Add the preset from the link?
linkPreset.text: The preset “{name}” goes to “My presets”. The preset in use does not change.

reason.port_busy: port 2090 is taken by another program
reason.tun_busy: Windows still holds the TUN adapter of an earlier start. Try again; if that does not help, restart Windows
reason.system_proxy_failed: the system proxy could not be set
reason.server_unsupported: Poros cannot connect to this server
reason.stop_timeout: the connection did not close in time; reset it in Help
reason.invalid_subscription: this does not look like a subscription
reason.no_servers: the subscription has no servers Poros can connect to
reason.invalid_url: a subscription link starts with http:// or https://
reason.single_server: This is a link to one server, not a subscription. Servers are added by hand in the advanced mode, which the first release does not have.
reason.check_failed: a part of the check failed
reason.invalid_entry: this is no site, address, subnet or program
reason.invalid_link: this is no Poros preset link
